purpose: Explore short-arc representative selection; no population accuracy or posterior calibration claim from this small corpus.
split: Development: Ceres, Pallas, Eros, Apophis. Held-out: Juno, Vesta, Bennu, Achilles. Split by object, not individual observation or epoch.
corpora: Preserve unconditional fixed-time corpus as input-validation stress evidence. Use separately preregistered altitude/night-selected corpus for solver accuracy, because below-horizon observations are excluded by upstream.
exploratoryAmendment: After mixed development-only outcomes from phase6d/min-rms, add predictive1d: select an actual accepted candidate minimizing squared chord distance to the unweighted family mean at original last observation UTC +1 day. Horizon/loss are frozen before held-out runs. This targets prediction loss under the existing heuristic candidate measure, not an inferred posterior or guaranteed orbital-element improvement.
budgetMeaning: Configured initial MAX_SR_ORBITS batch capacity, not necessarily total attempts. Record every SR batch and sum actual attempted trials; retries/expansions remain visible. Compare selectors only with matched families and work counts.

noise.exact: No injected noise; MPC quantization and independent model differences remain; supplied coordinate sigma 0.2 arcsec.
noise.gaussian: Independent zero-mean east/north Gaussian noise, sigma 0.2 arcsec; same draws for paired methods and budgets.
noise.biased: Independent sigma 0.2 arcsec plus common tracklet east/north Gaussian bias sigma 0.3 arcsec, solver still told sigma 0.2.
noise.contaminated: Independent sigma 0.2 plus a +3 arcsec east outlier at the third of four fitted positions, solver still told sigma 0.2. Stress case, excluded from primary performance aggregates.

primaryComparison: Paired one-hour arcs: phase6d vs position, same 100-candidate budget, independent Gaussian noise. Report 1-day and 7-day angular prediction error, reciprocal-a error, q/e/i errors, failure/exclusion rate and runtime. Repeat at 500 candidates as a search-budget sensitivity analysis.
secondaryComparison: min-rms diagnostic, exact and shared-bias/outlier stress cases. No tuning after held-out results are opened; negative results remain.
ensembleDiagnostics: Unweighted heuristic-sample 90% radius, empirical truth inclusion, width, energy score in Cartesian unit sky direction, full support and central-90% inverse-a/e/q/i inclusion. Samples are not posterior draws; none of these intervals has a probability guarantee.
followup: Paired experiment adds one prespecified later observation at +1d; evaluate +3d/+7d only. Visibility validation found every +6h target unobservable, so that proposed arm is not run. Every accepted case has a feasible +1d observation. The amendment is based only on visibility, before held-out outcomes. Independently validate the later observation against the same altitude/night rule.
trackletFollowupAmendment: Exploratory observational intervention after the single-next-night-point results: four positions spanning one hour at +24h/+24h20m/+24h40m/+25h, then optionally +48h/+48h20m/+48h40m/+49h, all relative to original last observation. Retain the original first-night noise and the exact noisy +24h point; common errors are shared within each tracklet. Retain fixed schedules; unavailable cases remain failures with reasons, never rescheduled. Compare matched observable subsets only. No additional algorithm tuning after held-out results.
numericalControl: Propagate each independent truth state with the baseline force model to measure propagation/coordinate floor; verify experimental position equals released port with fixed-count native comparator and matching WASM cases.
decision: Do not change release defaults unless evidence supports consistent improvement without important object-class regressions. Small case count limits inference; report object-level distributions, paired wins, tails and raw failures, not just pooled means.
outstanding: No formal proof of full solver or compiler. No new probabilistic prior or Jacobian-correct ranging implementation in this selector experiment. No release/publication authorized by this goal.
